name: PrintOptions
description: Contains print options for a presentation.
example:
With ActivePresentation
    With .PrintOptions
        .NumberOfCopies = 2
        .Collate = False
        .PrintColorType = ppPrintColor
        .PrintHiddenSlides = True
        .FitToPage = True
        .FrameSlides = True
        .OutputType = ppPrintOutputSlides
    End With
    .PrintOut
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: PrintColorType
properties.description: Returns or sets the way the specified document will be printed: in black and white, in pure black and white (also referred to as high contrast), or in color. Read/write.

properties.name: Collate
properties.description: Determines whether a complete copy of the specified presentation is printed before the first page of the next copy is printed. Read/write.

properties.name: FitToPage
properties.description: Determines whether the slides will be scaled to fill the page they're printed on. Read/write.

properties.name: FrameSlides
properties.description: Determines whether a thin frame is placed around the border of the printed slides. Read/write.

properties.name: NumberOfCopies
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of copies of a presentation to be printed. Read/write.

properties.name: OutputType
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates which component (slides, handouts, notes pages, or an outline) of the presentation is to be printed. Read/write.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: PrintHiddenSlides
properties.description: Determines whether hidden slides in the specified presentation will be printed. Read/write.

properties.name: PrintInBackground
properties.description: Determines whether the specified presentation is printed in the background. Read/write.

properties.name: RangeType
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of print range for the presentation. Read/write.

properties.name: Ranges
properties.description: Returns the PrintRanges object, which represents the ranges of slides in the presentation to be printed. Read-only.

properties.name: PrintFontsAsGraphics
properties.description: Determines whether TrueType fonts are printed as graphics. Read/write.

properties.name: SlideShowName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the custom slide show to print. Read/write .

properties.name: ActivePrinter
properties.description: Returns the name of the active printer. Read-only.

properties.name: HandoutOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets the page layout order in which slides appear on printed handouts that show multiple slides on one page. Read/write.

properties.name: PrintComments
properties.description: Sets or returns whether comments will be printed. Read/write.

properties.name: sectionIndex
properties.description: Returns the index of the selected section in the PrintOptions object. Read/write.

properties.name: HighQuality
properties.description: Indicates whether to print in high quality. Read/write.
